about: The key package versions of the tested environment, read by tools/lab_env.py and tools/doctor.py. A model package moves a stored result when its version moves, and a tooling package moves a check. Each version equals its pin in constraints.txt, which pins every package: pip install -r requirements-dev.txt -c constraints.txt. The python field is the release the environment was tested under, recorded as information, because the repository admits Python 3.10 and later.
